name: Enhanced Gaze
body:
Your sight-based abilities are more potent.

Prerequisite(s): One or more gaze feats, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): Whenever a character averts his eyes from you in order to avoid the effects of an ability that you gained from a feat with the [gaze] descriptor, he only has a 25% chance of avoiding that ability, rather than a 50% chance. You are still treated as gaining concealment from him.

Special: Many feats with the [gaze] descriptor have additional effects if you possess Enhanced Gaze. Such effects are described in the individual feat’s description.
